summary: Fixed the ledger package to follow docs/conventions.md: half-away-from-zero rounding (including recurring/spark), single leading minus in formatting and HTML totals, rate lookback only to earlier months, month_range import in the rate file reader, reversals booked and valued on the original's date, per-entry rounded totals (monthly, journal cells, revaluation), tax rules effective on their start date, returns by valuation quarter, header-over-dialect layout precedence, writer always emitting jurisdiction, and fiscal quarter year at the start month. All 755 tests pass and tools/audit.py reports 0 failed checks.
